instruction.name: fldgt.d
instruction.description: Floating-point bound-checked load, condition rj > rk.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r22, 8; st.d $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r22, -8; st.d $r22, $r20, 8; li.d $r21, 0' --asm 'fldgt.d $f0, $r20, $r21; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'
experiments.notes: rj -> fd chain; the movfr2gr.d (3) + add.d (1) closure is subtracted.

latencies.notes: rj -> fd chain; the movfr2gr.d (3) + add.d (1) closure is subtracted.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -2048; li.d $r22, -64; and $r20, $r20, $r22; li.d $r22, 0; st.d $r22, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, 0' --asm 'fldgt.d $f0, $r20, $r4; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; xori $r4, $r4, 1'
